findings.title: opportunity: soft-offer define on empty check/order
findings.evidence: No-story check with zero stories yields results=[] and all_pass true with soft_offer omitted; empty order has no handoff — vacuous green / empty list.
findings.recommendation: When results or ordered is empty, soft_offer define; do not treat vacuous all_pass as ready.

findings.title: opportunity: headless soft_offer needs target story
findings.evidence: Table says define/check '(that story)' but headless only exposes soft_offer string — no story id for the handoff target.
findings.recommendation: Add soft_offer_story when soft_offer is define/check and a target story is known.

findings.title: opportunity: soft-offer check after define success
findings.evidence: Define reports saved gate with no soft_offer; define→check verify loop is implicit.
findings.recommendation: After successful define, soft_offer check (interactive + headless).
